items.title: Video Agent by Fotor
items.name: Video Agent by Fotor
items.summary: Create and edit precision motion graphics & video with chat
items.description: Fotor Video Agent helps founders, marketers, and creators turn ideas, scripts, or raw assets into precision videos & motion graphics. It auto-orchestrates scenes, timing, visual FX, and kinetic typography—while keeping text, numbers, logos, and charts editable on a multi-track timeline before you render. Update stats at the last minute or refine timing without regenerating the whole video. Ship promos and explainers faster with zero black-box outputs and no tedious keyframes.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt! 👋

I’m Coral, Head of Growth at @Fotor .

We're thrilled to launch Fotor Video Agent - Create and edit precision motion graphics & video with chat.

Why we built this:

A few months ago, our team spent hours crafting a 90-second product video with AI. It looked perfect — until we spotted a typo in an animated chart. To fix one word, we had to re-run the entire prompt, burn more credits, and pray the next version would still look consistent. That felt backwards.

The problem with AI video today: Most tools give you a locked MP4. You can't edit text, swap a shot, or adjust timing without starting over. For growth teams iterating on campaigns, that's a dealbreaker.

Here's what makes Fotor Video Agent different:

• Editable multi-track timeline — Every text, number, logo, and chart stays editable before you render. Fix a typo without regenerating the whole video.

• AE-level animated infographics — Turn raw data into animated charts that stay live and parametric. No After Effects needed.

• End-to-end agent orchestration — Describe your idea, upload a PDF, or paste a script. The Agent plans, generates, and assembles everything on the timeline.

In our tests, what used to take 3-5 days now takes about 40 minutes.

Getting started: Bring a brief, raw assets, or even a rough idea. We'll help you turn it into a polished video project.

Quick demos:
• SaaS product walkthrough ➔ Watch
• Docs-to-explainer ➔ Watch

What's the one video editing task you wish AI could handle for you?

I'm here all day — happy to answer questions! 🚀
great launch.. I saw the video and was impressed to see the multiple timeline and audio track mode.. great stuff.. good wishes for its launch..
Fotor used to be a mobile app as well. Is the video editing part of the app now or its web only?

items.title: PostHog Desktop
items.name: PostHog Desktop
items.summary: The product editor for product builders
items.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.
top_comments:
PostHog Desktop (previously, PostHog Code) is an AI-powered product editor for product builders.

Problem: Most AI code editors lack real product context and start every session cold, so you’re still the one watching rollouts and catching regressions.

Solution: A multiplayer workspace where you, your team, and a fleet of agents build with your actual product data (logs, errors, session recordings, funnels, flags, experiments, tickets, etc.) as context.

What makes it different: It reads signals from production and turns them into shippable work, product signals go in, PRs come out. Unlike generic AI editors, it “knows your product” and can ship improvements while you sleep.

Key features:

  • Run a fleet of agents in parallel, with plan/auto modes and switchable models (Claude, Codex, open-weight).

  • Personal + team skills + skills marketplace, plus PostHog-maintained skills for events, flags, experiments, error tracking.

  • MCP marketplace integrations (GitHub, Slack, Linear, Figma, Stripe, Sentry, etc.).

  • Multiplayer channels with persistent memory so agents don’t need re-briefing.

  • Inbox that surfaces reports and pull requests from product signals.

Benefits: Less context-switching, faster iteration from idea → plan → PR, and more outcome-oriented work (you orchestrate, agents execute).

Who it’s for: Product builders and teams who want to move from writing code / prompting outputs to orchestrating outcomes with AI agents.

Use cases: Turning in-app activity, errors, funnel drop-offs, and support signals into concrete improvements and PRs; running parallel agent tasks across a shared workspace.

Try it on macOS (or other platforms) and read the docs.

P.S. I hunt the latest and greatest launches in tech, SaaS and AI, follow to be notified → @rohanrecommends

items.title: BrandJet
items.name: BrandJet
items.summary: Turn public buying signals into sales pipeline
items.description: BrandJet turns live buying signals into outbound pipeline. It listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and the open web for people asking about problems you solve, enriches every relevant signal into a lead, and reaches them on the channels they actually use. From first signal to outreach, unified inbox, CRM, and signed contract, BrandJet runs the entire motion in one platform. It's exposed through MCP so AI agents can run it too.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt,

Marsad, co-founder of BrandJet.

What is a lead? You bought 10,000 from a data vendor and 9,940 are a Gmail address attached to a guy who changed jobs during the pandemic. Meanwhile real buyers are posting "anyone know a good alternative to [your competitor]?" in public, right now, and your current GTM/sales stack can't account for that unless you pay for tool after tool, and still - just not it.

We fixed that spent the last year building one of the most comprehensive GTM platforms on the market - with a pretty insane MCP server.

What BrandJet does:

Listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn and the open web for mentions of your brand, your competitors, your category
Turns each signal into a lead with contact info and context
Reaches out on the channel they answer: email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, X, Instagram, Telegram
Lands every reply in one inbox, CRM behind it
Signs the contract in the same platform (Plutus, ours, long story)
Artemis, our AI agent, does the grunt work

Our platform listens before it speaks. People are saying it's the first outbound platform that does. The people are mostly Nirav, my co-founder, but he's very smart, so.

For the Claude and Codex crowd: the whole platform ships as an MCP server, 70+ tools across listening, enrichment, outreach, the inbox, the CRM. Point your agent at it and build the GTM workflows we didn't think of. Artemis runs on this exact layer, so anything our agent does, yours can do too. Bring your own agent.

Proof we believe it: we use BrandJet to sell BrandJet. Kafka would call it a trial with no verdict. It's going great.

Launch offer: Use BRANDJETHUNT30 for 30% off for the next three months ;)

Ask me anything, tell me what's broken and help me build a generational GTM platform.
which signals count as public, and how they keep it from being scraping people who never opted in?

the part that stands out to me is signing the contract in the same platform. once a deal gets to that stage, is there a human review step before terms go out, or is Artemis drafting and sending the contract itself too? that's the part I'd want a human in the loop on even if everything before it is automated.

A few months ago, our team spent hours crafting a 90-second product video with AI. It looked perfect — until we spotted a typo in an animated chart. To fix one word, we had to re-run the entire prompt, burn more credits, and pray the next version would still look consistent. That felt backwards.

The problem with AI video today: Most tools give you a locked MP4. You can't edit text, swap a shot, or adjust timing without starting over. For growth teams iterating on campaigns, that's a dealbreaker.

Here's what makes Fotor Video Agent different:

• Editable multi-track timeline — Every text, number, logo, and chart stays editable before you render. Fix a typo without regenerating the whole video.

• AE-level animated infographics — Turn raw data into animated charts that stay live and parametric. No After Effects needed.

• End-to-end agent orchestration — Describe your idea, upload a PDF, or paste a script. The Agent plans, generates, and assembles everything on the timeline.

In our tests, what used to take 3-5 days now takes about 40 minutes.

Getting started: Bring a brief, raw assets, or even a rough idea. We'll help you turn it into a polished video project.

Quick demos:
• SaaS product walkthrough ➔ Watch
• Docs-to-explainer ➔ Watch

What's the one video editing task you wish AI could handle for you?

I'm here all day — happy to answer questions! 🚀

items.title: PostHog Desktop
items.name: PostHog Desktop
items.summary: The product editor for product builders
items.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.
top_comments:
PostHog Desktop (previously, PostHog Code) is an AI-powered product editor for product builders.

Problem: Most AI code editors lack real product context and start every session cold, so you’re still the one watching rollouts and catching regressions.

Solution: A multiplayer workspace where you, your team, and a fleet of agents build with your actual product data (logs, errors, session recordings, funnels, flags, experiments, tickets, etc.) as context.

What makes it different: It reads signals from production and turns them into shippable work, product signals go in, PRs come out. Unlike generic AI editors, it “knows your product” and can ship improvements while you sleep.

Key features:

  • Run a fleet of agents in parallel, with plan/auto modes and switchable models (Claude, Codex, open-weight).

  • Personal + team skills + skills marketplace, plus PostHog-maintained skills for events, flags, experiments, error tracking.

  • MCP marketplace integrations (GitHub, Slack, Linear, Figma, Stripe, Sentry, etc.).

  • Multiplayer channels with persistent memory so agents don’t need re-briefing.

  • Inbox that surfaces reports and pull requests from product signals.

Benefits: Less context-switching, faster iteration from idea → plan → PR, and more outcome-oriented work (you orchestrate, agents execute).

Who it’s for: Product builders and teams who want to move from writing code / prompting outputs to orchestrating outcomes with AI agents.

Use cases: Turning in-app activity, errors, funnel drop-offs, and support signals into concrete improvements and PRs; running parallel agent tasks across a shared workspace.

Try it on macOS (or other platforms) and read the docs.

P.S. I hunt the latest and greatest launches in tech, SaaS and AI, follow to be notified → @rohanrecommends

items.title: BrandJet
items.name: BrandJet
items.summary: Turn public buying signals into sales pipeline
items.description: BrandJet turns live buying signals into outbound pipeline. It listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and the open web for people asking about problems you solve, enriches every relevant signal into a lead, and reaches them on the channels they actually use. From first signal to outreach, unified inbox, CRM, and signed contract, BrandJet runs the entire motion in one platform. It's exposed through MCP so AI agents can run it too.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt,

Marsad, co-founder of BrandJet.

What is a lead? You bought 10,000 from a data vendor and 9,940 are a Gmail address attached to a guy who changed jobs during the pandemic. Meanwhile real buyers are posting "anyone know a good alternative to [your competitor]?" in public, right now, and your current GTM/sales stack can't account for that unless you pay for tool after tool, and still - just not it.

We fixed that spent the last year building one of the most comprehensive GTM platforms on the market - with a pretty insane MCP server.

What BrandJet does:

Listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn and the open web for mentions of your brand, your competitors, your category
Turns each signal into a lead with contact info and context
Reaches out on the channel they answer: email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, X, Instagram, Telegram
Lands every reply in one inbox, CRM behind it
Signs the contract in the same platform (Plutus, ours, long story)
Artemis, our AI agent, does the grunt work

Our platform listens before it speaks. People are saying it's the first outbound platform that does. The people are mostly Nirav, my co-founder, but he's very smart, so.

For the Claude and Codex crowd: the whole platform ships as an MCP server, 70+ tools across listening, enrichment, outreach, the inbox, the CRM. Point your agent at it and build the GTM workflows we didn't think of. Artemis runs on this exact layer, so anything our agent does, yours can do too. Bring your own agent.

Proof we believe it: we use BrandJet to sell BrandJet. Kafka would call it a trial with no verdict. It's going great.

Launch offer: Use BRANDJETHUNT30 for 30% off for the next three months ;)

Ask me anything, tell me what's broken and help me build a generational GTM platform.
which signals count as public, and how they keep it from being scraping people who never opted in?

the part that stands out to me is signing the contract in the same platform. once a deal gets to that stage, is there a human review step before terms go out, or is Artemis drafting and sending the contract itself too? that's the part I'd want a human in the loop on even if everything before it is automated.

high_potential_items.title: janhq/jan
high_potential_items.name: jan
high_potential_items.summary: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 本地离线开源 ChatGPT 替代
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 借鉴其将大模型完全嵌入桌面应用、无需联网即可对话的产品定位，适合做本地优先的 AI 工具。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先做一个能加载本地模型并支持基础对话的桌面窗口。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 172；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 本地离线 AI 助手，可作为企业或个人应用的基础设施，与 AI 应用场景部分关联。

high_potential_items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
high_potential_items.name: scientific-agent-skills
high_potential_items.summary: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 将科学领域专家知识封装为标准化 agent skills，使不同 AI 编程工具都能直接调用这些科研能力。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先选取一个高频科研技能（如基因序列分析）做成标准 skill，并在单一 agent 工具中验证其可用性。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 6248；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 科学 Agent 技能库，虽社区热度高，但与雷达关注的垂直 AI 应用场景匹配度低。

high_potential_items.title: ConardLi/garden-skills
high_potential_items.name: garden-skills

high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 1370；已有较强社区验证

interest_sections.title: 邮件自动化工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub；外贸邮件自动化仍停留在工具推荐层面，但已经出现从人工工具向代理间邮件协调层演进的早期迹象。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 外贸人员希望减少邮件整理与客户跟进耗时，尤其需要解决客户已读不回等跟进场景下的邮件处理效率问题

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 小红书用户仍以求推荐现成软件和工具为主，讨论内容停留在“提升工作效率”的泛泛经验层面；GitHub 上已有面向 AI 编码代理的异步邮件层（如 mcp_agent_mail），提供身份、收件箱、可搜索线程等能力。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪为 AI 或销售代理内置邮件收件箱、线程与身份管理的基础设施方向，使代理能自主完成客户邮件的异步协调与跟进。

product_items.title: Dicklesworthstone/mcp_agent_mail
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「邮件自动化工具 / 开发者工具」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“外贸人员希望减少邮件整理与客户跟进耗时，尤其需要解决客户已读不回等跟进场景下的邮件处理效率问题”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传

interest_sections.title: 企业自动化工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、Product Hunt，核心观察是用户仍处于AI工具选型科普与转型焦虑并存阶段，而产品已开始用“一次性展示工作流生成agent”来承接这一需求。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 企业用户需要一张可对照的AI工具分类地图，判断不同业务场景该用哪类工具，同时工厂经营者对“不会用AI会被淘汰”有明确的转型焦虑

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论主要停留在AI工具科普和焦虑呼吁层面，常见内容形式是“一张图看懂AI工具”类清单；产品侧则出现Caddi这类“只展示一次工作流即可生成agent”的自动化产品，用产品化方式承接用户注意力。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是将工具选型科普升级为“输入现有业务流程、自动生成对应agent”的可操作方案，把用户从看地图选工具引导到直接复用工作流产出自动化结果。

interest_sections.title: AI 学习工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，核心是用户在知识库选型中兼顾笔记功能与本地掌控，而开源 AI Agent 正尝试把资料收集与记忆整合成一体。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 研究生用户需要一款本地可离线、能方便插入图片/代码/表格的文档笔记知识库工具，解决资料整理和笔记记录的实际任务

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论集中在 wolfai、Notion、Obsidian 等工具选型，有人 all in Notion，有人因离线问题倾向本地方案，也有人用卡片盒笔记法组织内容，尚无统一解法。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪本地优先、结合 AI 记忆自进化的知识库方向，让工具能根据用户使用自动整理资料并形成个性化记忆。

product_items.title: donghzs/vermes
product_items.highlight_one_liner: 开源自托管一体化AI Agent解决方案
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「AI 学习工具」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“研究生用户需要一款本地可离线、能方便插入图片/代码/表格的文档笔记知识库工具，解决资料整理和笔记记录的实际任务”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传

interest_sections.title: 语言 AI 陪练
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自xiaohongshu、GitHub，核心观察是口语练习不足的痛点正从经验贴转向用Agent做陪练，但尚未形成主流方案。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户需要在口语表达或考试题型（如PTE RA）上获得足够且具体的练习与反馈，而不是只有零散的经验技巧

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前主要靠小红书等平台的经验分享和考试技巧（如PTE口语RA经验）来弥补练习不足，同时GitHub上出现ielts-buddy这类将口语陪练、作文批改等打包成Agent技能的本地工具。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把考试评分标准和表达训练转成语料库与反馈逻辑，嵌入本地Agent或聊天工具，形成可反复使用的结构化口语陪练闭环。

product_items.title: Jobo16/ielts-buddy
product_items.highlight_one_liner: 雅思备考全流程 AI 陪练助手
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「语言 AI 陪练 / 开发者工具」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“用户需要在口语表达或考试题型（如PTE RA）上获得足够且具体的练习与反馈，而不是只有零散的经验技巧”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传
